title: Herbster Wood Fired Anagama Workshop
summary: A 16-day summer workshop in Herbster, Wisconsin where up to 12 potters work with an anagama kiln, including forming, glazing, and participating in round-the-clock stoking shifts during a four-day firing.
bring: Work created on-site during three-day forming period
evidence_sentence: The workshop teaches firing a traditional Anagama kiln over a 16-day session with stoking shifts and ash application.
